SECTION B: Very Short Answer Type Questions (2 Marks Each)

Q24. (a) Examine the role of ‘pressure groups’ in a democracy.  
OR  

(b) Examine the role of ‘opposition parties’ in a democracy.

Answer / Solution:
(a) Examine the role of ‘pressure groups’ in a democracy. 
They organize people with common interests to influence government policies 
without seeking political power. 
They provide a mechanism for public participation and keep the government 
responsive to specific needs. 
OR (b) Examine the role of ‘opposition parties’ in a democracy. 
They mobilize opposition to the government and voice different views. 
They criticize the government for failures and keep a check on the ruling party.
